newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-KENT RELEASE IGGLESDEN AND BENSON.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-KENT RELEASE IGGLESDEN AND BENSON.

text.p: Former England fast bowler Alan Igglesden and recent skipper Mark Benson are being released by Kent even though both still have a year left on their contracts.
Neither has played first-class cricket this season because of injury.
Benson, 38, has scored more than 18,000 runs for the county since 1980, but faces another knee operation next month after being hurt playing football in pre-season training.
Igglesden, 32 next month, has played only seven first class matches and 13 one-day games in the last two years. He won the last of his three test caps against the West Indies in 1993.
